title: CrossCodex Ingestion structured output
description: The document stored at structured_json_uri. Five rules are outside JSON Schema and are checked by the service in code: element_id values are unique, non-null id values are unique, a non-null parent_id names an earlier element, metadata.element_count equals the number of elements, and a section has at least one child element with an id and never sits under a control.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR version the output conforms to. This file validates every released 1.x: minors add fields that only their own version requires.

elementId.$comment: (?![\s\S]) anchors the end of the string; '$' would also accept a trailing newline in Python.
elementId.description: Opaque identifier, unique within the document: e- followed by 3 to 30 digits.

nonBlankString.description: Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

page.description: 1-based page the item starts on; null when the format has no pages or Docling recorded none.

content.description: Text of the element (a table is GitHub-flavoured Markdown). Never blank.

level.description: Heading depth; null for every other type.

parent_id.description: element_id of the heading this element sits under, or null at the top level.

id.description: Since 1.1. The element's ID in the source (a structured source's node ID), unique among non-null ids; null on an element that has no source ID of its own. Absent when the source has no IDs.

title.description: Since 1.1; null is allowed since 1.3. The source node's title. A heading may carry one only when its id is a string.

role.description: Since 1.3. Whether the source node is a catalog group or a control, as the mapping's group_levels declares; a control may have children. Since 1.4 also section: a lead-in that introduces its children but is not itself a requirement; it has at least one child and never sits under a control. Allowed only on an element whose id is a string.

text.description: Since 1.3. The source node's own body text, or null when it has none. Allowed only on an element whose id is a string.

properties.description: Since 1.1. Extra source fields the mapping names: lowercase identifier -> non-blank string.

allOf.description: Since 1.3. role and text describe a source node, so they need the node's string id.
A heading without a source id has no title: its title is its content.

level.description: A heading's level is an integer from 1 (top) to 100.

dropped.description: Source content that was not emitted as an element.

detected_format.description: Validated input format, e.g. pdf, html, docx, txt, json, csv, xlsx.

page_count.description: Pages in the source; null for unpaginated formats (HTML, DOCX, text, structured sources).

title.description: The document's title as Docling labelled it, or a structured source's mapping title; or null.

processing_time_ms.description: Wall time of the conversion worker in milliseconds.

structure_method.description: Since 1.4, and required from it. How the elements' structure was found: mapping, through the mapping in source.mapping; heading, table or pattern, the fallback structurer tier that found it in a document's layout.

allOf.description: Since 1.4. An output with source.mapping has structure_method mapping.

structuredSource.description: Since 1.1. Present when the input was a structured source read through a mapping.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the mapping file the conversion used.

catalog_version.description: Since 1.3. The version of the catalog the source describes, from the mapping's version key; null when the mapping has none.

unmapped_fields.description: Source fields (JSON keys on nodes, or column headers) the mapping did not use, in first-seen order.

structure.description: Since 1.2. Structure signals, so a consumer can judge extraction quality without re-reading the elements. Measured on the emitted elements, except for a 1.4 document: there on the layout the fallback structurer read, before it was replaced by the structure.

max_heading_depth.description: Deepest heading level; 0 when there are no headings.

fragment_count.description: Paragraph and list_item elements of only a few characters, such as stray list markers.

warnings.description: Machine-readable codes for suspect structure. Open-ended by design: a new code is not a schema change.

htmlProfile.description: Since 1.2. The HTML profile applied to the conversion, present only when one applied.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the profile file the conversion used.
